将尝试压缩 %@ 张图片。只有生成结果更小、且原文件自扫描后未变化时才会原位替换.en: This will try to compress %@ images. An original is replaced only if the result is smaller and the file has not changed since the scan.

将把 %lld 个未被 Markdown 引用的资源移入废纸篓。文件不会被永久删.zh-Hans: 将把 %lld 个未被 Markdown 引用的资源移入废纸篓。文件不会被永久删除；失效引用和扫描期间发生变化的文件会保留并标记为需复核。
将把 %lld 个未被 Markdown 引用的资源移入废纸篓。文件不会被永久删.en: This will move %lld resources not referenced by Markdown to the Trash. Files will not be permanently deleted; broken references and files changed during the scan will be kept and marked for review.

已扫描 %lld 个 Markdown 文件；远程 URL、代码块和行内代码不会.zh-Hans: 已扫描 %lld 个 Markdown 文件；远程 URL、代码块和行内代码不会被当作本地资源。
已扫描 %lld 个 Markdown 文件；远程 URL、代码块和行内代码不会.en: Scanned %lld Markdown files. Remote URLs, code blocks, and inline code are not treated as local resources.

当前连接档案没有 Base URL，点击下方档案即可快速切换到已配置服务。.en: The current connection profile has no Base URL. Select a profile below to switch quickly to a configured service.

扫描全仓库 Markdown 引用，清理孤立资源并安全压缩大图。.en: Scan Markdown references across the repository, clean up orphaned resources, and safely compress large images.
